name: Perimeter Surveying
description: On-foot walkthroughs of the target perimeter reveal details that no aerial or satellite imagery can capture — the exact type of door hardware on employee entrances, whether a badge reader is Wiegand or OSDP, which doors have REX sensors, where cameras have blind spots, and how employees behave at access points. Perimeter surveying should be conducted at multiple times of day and documented thoroughly. Body-worn cameras allow you to review footage later without raising suspicion during the walk.

blue.det: Individual spending extended time near perimeter without apparent purpose; returning multiple times at different hours.
blue.cm: Exterior cameras covering perimeter approaches; security patrol at irregular intervals; signage indicating surveillance.
